responsibility: This is the central C front-end interface header that extends GCC’s generic tree representation with C-specific flags, access macros, state variables, and function declarations. It defines lang-flag meanings for types, declarations, constructors, and SAVE_EXPRs; exposes parser/type-checker/building entry points for expressions, statements, initializers, OpenMP, and declarations; and publishes shared globals and helper APIs used across c-decl, c-parser, c-typeck, c-fold, and diagnostics code.
